title: IBM Db2 Genius Hub 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to conduct HTTP response…
description: IBM Db2 Genius Hub versions 1.1.2 through 1.1.5 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to perform HTTP response splitting due to improper neutralization of HTTP headers. This flaw can be exploited to manipulate HTTP responses, potentially leading to web cache poisoning or cross-user attacks. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3.
